ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The schematic diagram shows the Tarim River Basin. In the figure there are symbols for the basin boundary, rivers, and lakes, and rivers such as the Aksu River, the Yarkand River, and the Hotan River are marked. The rivers are distributed around the Tarim Basin and converge toward the direction of the mainstream; combined with the question stem, the Tarim River flows along the northern edge of the Taklamakan Desert and belongs to an inland river basin in an arid region. Reasoning: Historically, all nine major water systems once flowed into the mainstream of the Tarim River, indicating that these rivers originally had the water-volume conditions to connect with the mainstream; now only the Aksu River, the Yarkand River, and the Hotan River still maintain surface-water contact, indicating that the water volume of the other rivers has greatly decreased or even been cut off while flowing through the arid region. Rivers in arid regions already have strong evaporation and infiltration, and in modern times human activities along the way such as agricultural irrigation, water withdrawal, and canal construction have carried out disorderly development and excessive utilization of water resources, intercepting and consuming a large amount of runoff, causing there to be no water downstream to enter the mainstream. Therefore, the main reason why the other six rivers no longer maintain surface-water contact with the mainstream of the Tarim River is humans' disorderly development and utilization of water resources.

method.method_draft: 读图确认塔里木河流域处于干旱沙漠边缘，支流需要穿过干旱区才能汇入干流；结合题干说明历史上九大水系曾汇入而现在仅三条保持地表水联系。将“历史上有、现在无”的变化与干旱区内陆河水量被沿途截取消耗相联系，得出其他六条河流断流的主要原因是人类对水资源的无序开发和利用。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：示意图展示了塔里木河流域，图中有流域边界、河流和湖泊符号，标出了阿克苏河、叶尔羌河、和田河等河流，河流分布在塔里木盆地周边并向干流方向汇集；结合题干，塔里木河流经塔克拉玛干沙漠北缘，属于干旱区内陆河流域。
推理：历史上九大水系都曾汇入塔里木河干流，说明这些河流原本具备与干流连通的水量条件；现在仅阿克苏河、叶尔羌河、和田河仍保持地表水联系，说明其他河流在流经干旱区途中水量大幅减少甚至断流。干旱区河流本就蒸发、下渗强，而近现代沿途农业灌溉、取水、修渠等人类活动对水资源进行无序开发和过度利用，截留消耗了大量径流，导致下游无水入干流。因此其他六条河流不再与塔里木河干流保持地表水联系的主要原因是人类对水资源的无序开发和利用。
method.model_answer: 人类对水资源的无序开发和过度利用，沿途大量取水消耗，导致河流断流，不能再汇入塔里木河干流。

Image description: The schematic diagram shows the Tarim River Basin. In the figure there are symbols for the basin boundary, rivers, and lakes, and rivers such as the Aksu River, the Yarkand River, and the Hotan River are marked. The rivers are distributed around the Tarim Basin and converge toward the direction of the mainstream; combined with the question stem, the Tarim River flows along the northern edge of the Taklamakan Desert and belongs to an inland river basin in an arid region.
Reasoning: Historically, all nine major water systems once flowed into the mainstream of the Tarim River, indicating that these rivers originally had the water-volume conditions to connect with the mainstream; now only the Aksu River, the Yarkand River, and the Hotan River still maintain surface-water contact, indicating that the water volume of the other rivers has greatly decreased or even been cut off while flowing through the arid region. Rivers in arid regions already have strong evaporation and infiltration, and in modern times human activities along the way such as agricultural irrigation, water withdrawal, and canal construction have carried out disorderly development and excessive utilization of water resources, intercepting and consuming a large amount of runoff, causing there to be no water downstream to enter the mainstream. Therefore, the main reason why the other six rivers no longer maintain surface-water contact with the mainstream of the Tarim River is humans' disorderly development and utilization of water resources.

critic_agent_reviews.critic_suggestions: 验证通过。推理轨迹先描述图像、再结合题干推理，顺序符合图像题要求；最终原因与标准答案“人类对水资源的无序开发和利用”一致。图像中确有塔里木河流域示意、边界/河流图例，以及阿克苏河、叶尔羌河、和田河、台特玛湖等标注；题干提供塔克拉玛干沙漠北缘和九大水系变化信息。若需更严谨，可把“农业灌溉、取水、修渠”等表述明确为对标准答案的具体化解释，而非图中直接读出的信息。
推理链总体合格：先描述图像要素，再结合题干进行原因分析，最终结论与标准答案一致。图像描述中的经纬度范围、内陆河流域、主要河流和台特玛湖等信息基本可由图中读出；“无出海通道”属于根据内陆流域边界和区域位置作出的合理概括。无需实质修改。
